subject: 970 Fellsway 40B Comprehensive Permit Review
overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals conducted a detailed review of civil engineering and traffic peer studies for a proposed 289-unit 40B housing development at 970 Fellsway. The board and consultants discussed site circulation, stormwater management improvements, and traffic mitigation strategies for surrounding intersections.

items.title: Chairmanship Announcement
items.summary: Mike Caldera announced that despite the recent election of a new chair for the board, he would continue as acting chair specifically for the 970 Fellsway hearing to ensure procedural consistency.

items.title: 970 Fellsway Civil Engineering Presentation
items.summary: The applicant presented updates to the civil site plan, highlighting 66 EV parking spaces, improved underground stormwater infiltration systems, and a site circulation design intended to discourage residents from using Myrtle Street as a primary access point.

items.title: Civil Peer Review Feedback
items.summary: BETA Group representatives confirmed the site layout is appropriate but recommended the board condition the approval on a construction management plan and further ADA compliance verification for pedestrian ramps.

items.title: Public Comment on Civil Design
items.summary: A resident expressed concerns regarding the effectiveness of signs and speed bumps in controlling tenant driving behavior on the private property and requested clarification on internal security monitoring.

items.title: Traffic and Transportation Presentation
items.summary: The applicant’s traffic consultant defended the project's traffic counts and modal split assumptions, advising against a median break at Myrtle Street due to pedestrian safety risks and potential cut-through traffic.

items.title: Traffic Peer Review Feedback
items.summary: BETA Group noted that several nearby intersections are already failing or are high-crash locations, suggesting the developer explore signal optimization and curb extensions to improve safety.

items.title: Scheduling and Future Proceedings
items.summary: The board scheduled a meeting for May 16 to review the waiver list and proposed conditions, with a final session intended for May 21 to vote on the comprehensive permit.

items.title: Administrative Items and Minutes
items.summary: The board postponed the review of meeting minutes from March and April until the following week.
